e1.context:
## 3. Formats
R8. The default format is CSV with a header row.
R9. With --format json the service writes one JSON array per file.
R10. Dates in all formats use the ISO 8601 form in UTC.

## 4. Limits
R11. A single export file holds at most 100000 rows; larger results are split across files.
e1.text: Dates in all formats use the ISO 8601 form in UTC.

finding.title: ISO 8601 has several forms
finding.wrong_outcome: Because iSO 8601 also allows a basic form without dashes, anyone who follows the text as given to the letter ends up with dates as 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z (`Dates in all formats use the ISO 8601 form in UTC.`, S:17); that is therefore wrong.
